files.README.md:
# sequelize-ddl-postgresql

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: entities, repositories and services with Sequelize 6. It does not create or migrate the database.

## Settings

- Database: postgresql; code: asynchronous (every method returns a Promise).
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no class for.
- Services: take and return DTOs (interfaces).
- Transactions: one transaction per service operation, committed when it ends.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
src/models.ts          the Sequelize models, as the database has them
src/database.ts        the database: DATABASE_URL, its Sequelize instance and models
src/errors.ts          NotFoundError, ConflictError, ValidationFailedError: no HTTP codes
src/unit-of-work.ts    the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
src/entities/          one entity per table
src/repositories/      one repository per table
src/services/          one service per table
test/                  repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json     what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
npm install
npm run typecheck && npm run build
TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://app:app@localhost:5432/app npm test   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.

/** What services take and return for the "Order" table. */

/** The values of a new Order. Optional fields left out take the database's default. */
export interface OrderCreate {
  user: string
  group?: number
  customerName: string
  class_?: string | null
  metadata?: string | null
  date?: string | null
  time?: string | null
  text?: string | null
  list?: string | null
  str?: string | null
  int?: number | null
  dueDate: string
  closesAt?: string | null
  kindCode?: string | null
  kindDay?: string | null
  thingId?: string | null
  parentId?: number | null
}

/** The values of a Order that change; fields left out keep their value. */
export interface OrderUpdate {
  user?: string
  group?: number
  customerName?: string
  class_?: string | null
  metadata?: string | null
  date?: string | null
  time?: string | null
  text?: string | null
  list?: string | null
  str?: string | null
  int?: number | null
  dueDate?: string
  closesAt?: string | null
  kindCode?: string | null
  kindDay?: string | null
  thingId?: string | null
  parentId?: number | null
}

/** A Order as services return it. */
export interface OrderRead {
  id: number
  user: string

  customerName: string
  class_: string | null
  metadata: string | null
  date: string | null

  str: string | null
  int: number | null
  dueDate: string

  parentId: number | null
}
